publicReleaseNotes:
Nook 0.4.0 is a web team workspace where conversations, decisions and commitments stay together. Since 0.3.0 it adds channel lifecycle, default channels, posting permissions and @channel/@here/@everyone; automatic thread following, a Threads view and All unreads with undo; search across messages, file names and plain-text/PDF text; Files views, private Saved items with reminders and channel pins; personal and channel reminders; scheduled and recurring messages; durable drafts, Drafts & sent, rich formatting, profiles and keyboard editing; reviewed Slack, Campfire and Mattermost imports as read-only history; and readable HTML/JSON exports with an owner-controlled whole-workspace exit. Local development sends and stores no mail. Nook pins @runeditrun/rer 0.2.63.

Back up first: on a hosted Nook sign in as an owner and use Download workspace archive at /export (rer export is local-only); locally stop Nook and run rer export. Then git pull --ff-only and rer deploy for the same environment (supply MAIL_FROM and SENDGRID_API_KEY once when updating from 0.3.0), or rer setup and rer dev locally. 22 additive migrations (0026–0043 and 0061–0063) apply in order; 0026_retire_captured_mail.sql drops only the old development mail capture table. Never reset populated state to update.

Not in this release: Microsoft Teams, Google Chat and Zulip migration, native apps, calls and screen sharing, an app/bot platform and webhooks, shared channels, link previews, SSO/2FA, retention and compliance tooling, and the contract's accountable agents. Known issues: invitation lifetime is shown as 15 minutes on Team and 7 days on the acceptance page; search date filters use UTC; a 0.3.0 checkout's rer 0.2.19 may fail to start or deploy on busy machines or large Cloudflare accounts, so update the source first.

agentUpdateInstructions: Updating from 0.3.0 to 0.4.0: preserve the existing owner, data, private settings, resource identities and every applied migration byte. Export first: on a hosted Nook sign in as an owner and download the workspace archive at /export (or use scripts/local/remote-export.mjs as docs/backups.md shows); rer export is local-only and refuses a hosted origin. Locally, stop Nook by its own process and run rer export. Fast-forward the checkout to the 0.4.0 source; rer installs the pinned 0.2.63 package and tools. Hosted: rer deploy with the same Cloudflare account and --environment, supplying MAIL_FROM and SENDGRID_API_KEY once so MAIL_API_KEY is bound. Local: rer setup then rer dev. The 22 new migrations (0026_retire_captured_mail.sql through 0063_workspace_export_policy_notices.sql) are additive except that 0026_retire_captured_mail.sql drops the development mail capture table; never reset populated state to update. Remove any local outbox references; local development sends and stores no mail. Restoring an archive is a separate empty-target local operation: follow OPERATIONS.md#restoring-a-local-archive.
